items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We lost Bucky Pizzarelli then Mike Longo and Ellis Marsalis... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Very sad.

ctx.x: No? Oh lost, you mean lost, oh. I did. I lost one friend from my twelve-step group, yeah. He was a healthcare worker and I very much liked him and he was a huge contributor to the program. So yeah, he died, very early on, in March.
There was a period of about seven days where it seemed like the musicians were being targeted almost. We lost Bucky Pizzarelli then Mike Longo and Ellis Marsalis and it was very sad of course.
Yeah. Very sad. Very, very sad. And there’s one author who is on FaceBook who keeps writing about the Broadway people that have died that he knew of, quite a few.
